lines.text: Many learners say: I and my friend went.
Better: My friend and I went.
My friend and I! My friend and I went to the park.

native.tip: Türkçede “ben ve arkadaşım” deriz; İngilizcede “I” sona gelir: “My friend and I went.”
native.caption: “I and my friend went” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede kibarlık için “I” sona konur. Doğrusu “My friend and I went.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “My friend and I”. I sona gelir. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: Put yourself last: “My friend and I went.”
en.caption: Do you say “I and my friend went”? 😅 In English, “I” politely goes last. The right sentence is “My friend and I went.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
